proposedDirectQuizPairs.rationale: Actual speech meanings and named modern Daijisen usage comparison overlap through speaking. Preserve utterance versus conversation/language-use teaching, not unrestricted substitution.
Actual broad speaking label can be defensible for the flowing/chattering speech use, independently of other speech guards. Not a claim that 言う itself asserts fluency.
proposedDirectQuizPairs.rightActualCaption: бегло говорить; болтать; тонкий и непрочный

proposedDirectQuizPairs.rationale: Actual broad speaking label can describe the speaking activity in the complete chat object. Independently judge the noun/verb boundary; no personality claim for 言う.
Both complete primary sources and exact objects independently teach naming; modern Daijisen explicitly has 名づける/称する/…と呼ぶ. Russian звать also names a person. Not telephone-call inference.
Exact 教える has telling/informing; modern Daijisen 言う explicitly transmits thoughts/judgments to someone. New сообщать can fit that direct telling use, not every teaching use.
Actually read named modern Daijisen 言う independently gives animal vocalization 犬がわんわんいう. This fits the actual animal-call caption, without promoting it as the primary N5 lesson.
Exact 話 sense1 conversation/talk and the complete accepted conversation body establish overlap, not mere shared 話.
Exact 話 sense1 chat and exact kana-marked お喋り chat sense independently meet the actual conversation caption. Not inherited through 会話.
Exact 話 sense4 explicitly rumor/hearsay; actual accepted 噂 caption fits. Not a claim that all stories are rumors.
Actual conversation label can fit the chattering speech use of the complete object; review grammatical-label boundary separately, not via おしゃべり transitivity.
proposedDirectQuizPairs.rightActualCaption: бегло говорить; болтать; тонкий и непрочный

proposedDirectQuizPairs.rationale: Both exact objects and complete primary sources explicitly have question senses. Keep inquiry-to-person versus exam/task/trouble explanation.
Exact 質問 is a noun/suru verb inquiry; exact 聞く independently asks/inquires. Actual asking caption is a defensible verbal gloss, not a claim that noun 質問 takes ordinary verb endings.
Exact 話す sense2 tell/explain and exact 教える sense2 inform independently overlap with the actual new informing label. Not inferred through 言う.
Exact teacher-led study and actual accepted study activity overlap. Do not equate every independent study session with receiving instruction.
Exact 習う includes getting training; exact 練習 training/practice is the actual accepted caption. Review direct training/instruction boundary without inferring a learning clique.
Exact 知る sense4 independently remembers/is familiar with; actual new помнить fits that memory sense. Preserve acquisition versus knowledge/state explanation.
Exact 覚える sense2 learn/acquire raises actual accepted изучение. Submitted separately for independent activity/acquisition adjudication; no memorization-from-English-word-alone proof.
Exact 覚える learn/acquire and exact 習う learn under instruction raise a direct learning overlap. Independently judge the qualified teacher-led Russian label, not a transitive inference through 勉強.
Actually read named modern Daijisen 頼む sense4 explicitly calls someone to do something, with 医者を頼む; actual 呼ぶ calling/summoning caption fits. Not an English call-phone inference.
Complete primary sources/objects independently name written compositions. Generic written-text label can fit the resulting composition; retain assignment/activity versus broader prose distinction.
Actual complete accepted 手紙 is a written message/document; generic written-text label is defensible for it. Not every text is a personal letter; no paper-material or handwriting inference.
Both complete objects and accepted/source articles independently overlap in academic examinations and practical testing.
Exact テスト sense3 explicitly rehearsal raises the actual training/practice caption. Submitted directly, not inferred from testing/education tags or exam pair.

sourceAdaptationDecisions: Translate every learner-facing section, meaning, example translation and source label; keep all Japanese examples/readings/forms, stable metadata and source qualifications.
Replace English-dependent answer/direct-object/remember/ask comparisons with the same Japanese roles/rules and natural Russian context, not particle-case or ている-aspect formulae.
Use natural обучать for teaching; actual Russian учить also studies/memorizes as captured, so do not equate pedagogical converse roles. Dictionary material is evidence, not blanket equivalence.
No new assets/scenes/strokes/mandatory kanji/grammar vocabulary contexts; word kanji fields preserved even absent kanji cards. Remove only unavailable optional link wrappers.
Preserve prose versus handwriting, voice versus understood content, request versus actual compliance, instruction versus mastery and all exact source attributions.
All23 direct guards remain proposals for whole independent reading. No transitive clique, source-English acceptance or native assertion.
